title: Clear four-nurse theatre allocation
summary: Separates who is present, theatre placement and shared Pager so no nurse appears assigned before the team chooses them.
changes: Shows the four nurses present tonight directly in the four-nurse theatre allocation editor.
Leaves a vacant theatre position visibly as Select nurse instead of allowing iOS to display the first nurse as if selected.
Removes the automatic suggestion that placed the normal Pager nurse into a vacant theatre role before confirmation.
Shared Pager now waits for the theatre arrangement to be explicitly saved when a theatre nurse is absent.
If the normal Pager nurse is the absent nurse, the four existing theatre nurses remain valid and can proceed to manual Pager ordering.
